import h5py, numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

def dec(ds): return [x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in ds[:]]
def load_meta(fn):
    f=h5py.File(fn,'r')
    guides=dec(f['obs/guide/categories']); gc=f['obs/guide/codes'][:].astype(int)
    genes=dec(f['var/_index'])
    return f,guides,gc,genes

def col(f, j):
    indptr=f['X/indptr']; indices=f['X/indices']; data=f['X/data']
    a=int(indptr[j]); b=int(indptr[j+1])
    v=np.zeros(f['X'].attrs['shape'][0], dtype=float)
    v[indices[a:b]]=data[a:b]
    return v

def group_means(vals, codes, cats):
    out=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(cats):
        m=codes==i
        if m.sum(): out.append((c, vals[m].mean(), int(m.sum())))
    return out
for fn in ['perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad','perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad']:
    f,guides,gc,genes=load_meta(fn)
    print('\\nFILE', fn)
    nt=[i for i,g in enumerate(guides) if g.startswith('NT-')]
    ntmask=np.isin(gc,nt)
    for gene in ['PABPC1','NUDT21','LEO1']:
        j=genes.index(gene)
        vals=col(f,j)
        ntmean=vals[ntmask].mean()
        means=group_means(vals,gc,guides)
        non=[x for x in means if not x[0].startswith('NT-')]
        rank_low=sorted(non, key=lambda x:x[1])[:10]
        print(gene,'NTmean',round(ntmean,3),'lowest',[(g,round(m,3),n) for g,m,n in rank_low])
    f.close()

import h5py, numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from collections import defaultdict

def dec(ds): return [x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in ds[:]]
def load(fn):
    f=h5py.File(fn,'r')
    shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape'])
    X=sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][:].astype(np.float64), f['X/indices'][:], f['X/indptr'][:]), shape=shape).tocsr()
    guides=dec(f['obs/guide/categories']); codes=f['obs/guide/codes'][:].astype(int)
    genes=dec(f['var/_index'])
    f.close()
    return X,guides,codes,genes

def norm_log(X):
    lib=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    scale=np.divide(1e4, lib, out=np.zeros_like(lib, dtype=float), where=lib>0)
    Y=X.multiply(scale[:,None]).tocsr()
    Y.data=np.log1p(Y.data)
    return Y

def group_sigs(Y, guides, codes):
    nt_idx=[i for i,g in enumerate(guides) if g.startswith('NT-')]
    ntmask=np.isin(codes, nt_idx)
    ntmean=np.asarray(Y[ntmask].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    sigs={}
    ns={}
    means={}
    for i,g in enumerate(guides):
        m=codes==i
        if m.sum()==0: continue
        mean=np.asarray(Y[m].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
        means[g]=mean
        sigs[g]=mean-ntmean
        ns[g]=int(m.sum())
    return sigs,means,ns,ntmean
Xr,gr,cr,genesr=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad')
Xq,gq,cq,genesq=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
Yr=norm_log(Xr); Yq=norm_log(Xq)
sigr,meanr,nr,ntr=group_sigs(Yr,gr,cr); sigq,meanq,nq,ntq=group_sigs(Yq,gq,cq)
common=sorted(set(genesr)&set(genesq))
ri=np.array([genesr.index(g) for g in common])
qi=np.array([genesq.index(g) for g in common])
ref_guides=[g for g in gr if not g.startswith('NT-')]
query_guides=[g for g in gq if not g.startswith('NT-')]
R=np.vstack([sigr[g][ri] for g in ref_guides])
Q=np.vstack([sigq[g][qi] for g in query_guides])
# zscore per signature for Pearson
def zrow(A):
    A=A.copy()
    A-=A.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    sd=A.std(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    sd[sd==0]=1
    return A/sd
C=zrow(R)@zrow(Q).T/R.shape[1]
print('common genes',len(common),'R',R.shape,'Q',Q.shape)
for target in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2']:
    i=ref_guides.index(target)
    order=np.argsort(C[i])[::-1]
    print('\\nREF',target,'n',nr[target])
    print([(query_guides[j], float(C[i,j]), nq[query_guides[j]]) for j in order[:10]])
# reciprocal top matches for all
print('\\nTop ref->query')
for i,rg in enumerate(ref_guides):
    j=int(np.argmax(C[i]));
    print(rg, '->', query_guides[j], C[i,j])
print('\\nTop query->ref')
for j,qg in enumerate(query_guides):
    i=int(np.argmax(C[:,j]));
    print(qg, '->', ref_guides[i], C[i,j])

# Recompute signatures once, then compare scoring variants and Hungarian assignment.
import h5py, numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

def dec(ds): return [x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in ds[:]]
def load(fn):
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape'])
        X=sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][:].astype(float), f['X/indices'][:], f['X/indptr'][:]), shape=shape).tocsr()
        guides=dec(f['obs/guide/categories']); codes=f['obs/guide/codes'][:].astype(int); genes=dec(f['var/_index'])
    return X,guides,codes,genes

def lognorm(X, scale=1e4):
    lib=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel(); s=np.divide(scale,lib,out=np.zeros_like(lib),where=lib>0)
    Y=X.multiply(s[:,None]).tocsr(); Y.data=np.log1p(Y.data); return Y

def sigs(Y,guides,codes):
    nt=np.array([i for i,g in enumerate(guides) if g.startswith('NT-')])
    ntm=np.isin(codes,nt)
    base=np.asarray(Y[ntm].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
    out={}; mean={}
    for i,g in enumerate(guides):
        m=codes==i
        if m.sum():
            mu=np.asarray(Y[m].mean(axis=0)).ravel(); mean[g]=mu; out[g]=mu-base
    return out,mean,base

def corr(A,B):
    A=A-A.mean(1,keepdims=True); B=B-B.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    A=A/np.maximum(A.std(1,keepdims=True),1e-12); B=B/np.maximum(B.std(1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
    return A@B.T/A.shape[1]
Xr,gr,cr,genr=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad'); Xq,gq,cq,genq=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
Yr=lognorm(Xr); Yq=lognorm(Xq)
sigr,meanr,baser=sigs(Yr,gr,cr); sigq,meanq,baseq=sigs(Yq,gq,cq)
ref=[g for g in gr if not g.startswith('NT-')]; que=[g for g in gq if not g.startswith('NT-')]
common=list(set(genr)&set(genq)); ri=np.array([genr.index(g) for g in common]); qi=np.array([genq.index(g) for g in common])
variants=[]
# all common
variants.append(('all', ri, qi))
# exclude mitochondrial/ribo? and genes with low signal? compute top variance in ref+query signatures
Rall=np.vstack([sigr[g][ri] for g in ref]); Qall=np.vstack([sigq[g][qi] for g in que])
var=(Rall.var(0)+Qall.var(0))
for k in [500,1000,2000,5000,10000]:
    idx=np.argsort(var)[-k:]
    variants.append((f'topvar{k}', ri[idx], qi[idx]))
# top abs ref PAB/NUDT/LEO separately? later
for name,rii,qii in variants:
    R=np.vstack([sigr[g][rii] for g in ref]); Q=np.vstack([sigq[g][qii] for g in que]); C=corr(R,Q)
    print('\\nVAR',name,'n',len(rii))
    for rg in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2','CDC73-I2','CTR9-I7','PAF1-I6']:
        i=ref.index(rg); top=np.argsort(C[i])[::-1][:5]
        print(rg, [(que[j], round(float(C[i,j]),3)) for j in top])
    # Hungarian (rectangular: 33 ref,32 query, assigns all query to subset refs max sum)
    rows,cols=linear_sum_assignment(-C) # assigns min(dim)=32 rows? rows length 32, subset of rows
    pairs=sorted(zip(rows,cols), key=lambda x: ref[x[0]])
    lookup={ref[i]:que[j] for i,j in zip(rows,cols)}
    print('assign requested', {rg:lookup.get(rg) for rg in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2','CDC73-I2','CTR9-I7','PAF1-I6']})

import h5py, numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment

def dec(ds): return [x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in ds[:]]
def load(fn):
    with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
        X=sparse.csc_matrix((f['X/data'][:].astype(float),f['X/indices'][:],f['X/indptr'][:]),shape=tuple(f['X'].attrs['shape'])).tocsr()
        return X, dec(f['obs/guide/categories']), f['obs/guide/codes'][:].astype(int), dec(f['var/_index'])
def lognorm(X):
    lib=np.asarray(X.sum(1)).ravel(); s=np.divide(1e4,lib,out=np.zeros_like(lib,dtype=float),where=lib>0)
    Y=X.multiply(s[:,None]).tocsr(); Y.data=np.log1p(Y.data); return Y
def mean_var(Y, mask):
    n=int(mask.sum()); sub=Y[mask]
    mean=np.asarray(sub.mean(0)).ravel()
    sq=sub.copy(); sq.data **= 2
    mean2=np.asarray(sq.mean(0)).ravel()
    var=np.maximum(mean2-mean*mean,0)
    return mean,var,n
def t_sigs(Y,g,c):
    ntidx=[i for i,x in enumerate(g) if x.startswith('NT-')]
    ntmask=np.isin(c,ntidx)
    bm,bv,bn=mean_var(Y,ntmask)
    sig={}; diff={}; n={}
    for i,x in enumerate(g):
        m=c==i
        if not m.sum(): continue
        gm,gv,gn=mean_var(Y,m)
        se=np.sqrt(gv/max(gn,1)+bv/max(bn,1)+1e-8)
        sig[x]=(gm-bm)/se
        diff[x]=gm-bm
        n[x]=gn
    return sig,diff,n

def corr(A,B):
    A=A-A.mean(1,keepdims=True); B=B-B.mean(1,keepdims=True)
    A=A/np.maximum(A.std(1,keepdims=True),1e-12); B=B/np.maximum(B.std(1,keepdims=True),1e-12)
    return A@B.T/A.shape[1]
Xr,gr,cr,genr=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.ref.h5ad'); Xq,gq,cq,genq=load('perturb.seq.align.q1.query.h5ad')
Yr=lognorm(Xr); Yq=lognorm(Xq)
tr,dr,nr=t_sigs(Yr,gr,cr); tq,dq,nq=t_sigs(Yq,gq,cq)
common=list(set(genr)&set(genq)); ri=np.array([genr.index(x) for x in common]); qi=np.array([genq.index(x) for x in common])
ref=[x for x in gr if not x.startswith('NT-')]; que=[x for x in gq if not x.startswith('NT-')]
Rall=np.vstack([tr[x][ri] for x in ref]); Qall=np.vstack([tq[x][qi] for x in que])
# cap t to reduce sample size dominance
for cap in [None,10,5,3]:
    R=Rall.copy(); Q=Qall.copy()
    if cap:
        R=np.clip(R,-cap,cap); Q=np.clip(Q,-cap,cap)
    var=R.var(0)+Q.var(0)
    for name,idx in [('all',np.arange(R.shape[1])),('top500',np.argsort(var)[-500:]),('top1000',np.argsort(var)[-1000:]),('top2000',np.argsort(var)[-2000:])]:
        C=corr(R[:,idx],Q[:,idx])
        print('\\ncap',cap,'set',name)
        for rg in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2','CDC73-I2','CTR9-I7','PAF1-I6']:
            i=ref.index(rg); top=np.argsort(C[i])[::-1][:6]
            print(rg,[(que[j],round(float(C[i,j]),3)) for j in top])
        rows,cols=linear_sum_assignment(-C); lookup={ref[i]:que[j] for i,j in zip(rows,cols)}
        print('assign', {rg:lookup.get(rg) for rg in ['PABPC1-I1','NUDT21-I3','LEO1-I2','CDC73-I2','CTR9-I7','PAF1-I6']})
PY"
